# Bhilwara Assembly constituency

| type = SLA
| constituency_no    = 180
}}
Bhilwara is one of the 200 Legislative Assembly constituencies of Rajasthan state in India. It is in Bhilwara district and Bhilwara Lok Sabha Constituency.
